label: A necessary concrete holder of a power for w obtaining, by Pruss's own direction (inference)
rule: Ground w's obtaining at a world lacking the actual contingents, locate the holder at w, reductio on its contingency
meaning: P4-prime gives an accessible world v lacking every actual contingent concretum; P5's witness shows v is not w; symmetric access gives v's access to w; grounding at v gives a being y at v with a power for w's obtaining; initiator presence puts y at w; y is concrete. Were y absent at a world accessible from w, it would be an actual contingent concretum, hence absent at v, where it exists. Excluded middle gives y's existence at every world accessible from w.
